meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 让项目能接入 Webex 频道：它会加入 Webex 适配器代码并注册频道、装好依赖并跑构建/测试；随后提示你去建 Webex 机器人，把访问令牌和 Webhook 密钥写进环境变量，在服务运行时自动开启接收 Webex 消息的本地服务。
howto.when: 当你要求添加、接入或启用 Webex 频道时；或在安装/设置流程中轮到接通 Webex 这一步时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Webex 频道接进来。
say.note: 开始执行本技能，添加并注册适配器。

say.text: 让 Webex 空间里的消息能发到机器人，设置一下。
say.note: 会引导填 Bot Token 和 Webhook 密钥。

say.text: 给这个项目加一个 Webex 聊天入口。
say.note: 安装依赖并跑验证测试。

howto.what_en: Adds a Webex chat channel: copies and registers the Webex adapter, installs a pinned dependency, builds and tests it, then asks for a bot token and webhook secret. A webhook server receives Webex messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add, enable, or integrate a Webex channel; also used during setup when this step is needed.

say_en.text: Help me add Webex as a channel.
say_en.note: Runs this skill to copy and register the adapter.

say_en.text: Set up Webex so messages from a space reach the bot.
say_en.note: Prompts for the bot token and webhook secret.

say_en.text: Add a Webex chat entry point to this project.
say_en.note: Installs the dependency and runs the verification test.
